title: pilosella praealta subsp. albidobractea
intro: Pilosella praealta subsp. albidobractea, commonly known as White-headed Hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family. It is used in traditional medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella praealta subsp. albidobractea are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
